player_0.content: New plan: I failed to identify the specific type of quadrilateral because I stopped calculating after finding opposite sides were equal (parallelogram) without checking if adjacent sides were perpendicular to confirm a rectangle. I should have calculated the slopes of adjacent sides (e.g., Side 1 and Side 2) to verify if their product equals -1. Since the shape has 4 vertices and opposite sides are equal, it is either a rectangle, rhombus, or square. By checking the slopes, I can definitively determine if it is a rectangle (Option H). I will calculate the slope of the first segment and the second segment, multiply them, and if the result is -1, I will select "rectangle".
